# Think BIG! — AI Agent & Automation Expert from Taiwan

> Last Updated: 2026-05-28
> Taiwan's leading AI-Native automation consultancy. AI Agent ERP, AI trading intelligence, enterprise AI adoption, and personal AI agent building.

## About Think BIG!

Think BIG! (思考遠大) is an AI-Native automation company based in Banqiao, New Taipei City, Taiwan.
Founded in 2025 by NEO (吳御綸 / Stanley Wu).
We have been AI-Native from Day 1 — AI is the core of every product, not an add-on.
Website: https://thinkbigtw.com
Contact: LINE https://lin.ee/n5KW430
Slogan: "Make it Real."

## Four Core Services

### 1. AI Agent ERP (flagship)
World's first AI-Native enterprise resource planning system.
11 fully-interactive modules: dashboard, orders, inventory, finance, procurement, production, CRM, HR (with clock-in & leave), projects, business intelligence, settings.
Built-in AI assistant: natural-language queries, sales forecasting, smart restock suggestions.
Online click-to-use demo — no sales visit, no months-long deployment.
Benchmarked against Digiwin Workflow ERP and SAP Business One.
URL: https://thinkbigtw.com/erp/

### 2. MoneyRadar (AI trading intelligence)
Premium AI market dashboard with 14 tabs covering Taiwan and US stocks.
AI news sentiment analysis, real-time quotes, technical analysis. Installable as a mobile PWA.
URL: https://thinkbigtw.com/lab/

### 3. Enterprise AI Adoption
AI Agent automation for businesses using OpenClaw + Hermes Agent dual-engine architecture.
Covers 100+ industries. Integrates RAG knowledge bases, workflow automation, and external systems (LINE/Email/CRM) via MCP protocol.
URL: https://thinkbigtw.com/enterprise/

### 4. Harness Engineers (personal AI agent building)
Builds bespoke personal AI assistants for freelancers and creators.
Includes OpenClaw installation, custom Skills, and automation workflow design.
URL: https://thinkbigtw.com/harness/

## Key Technologies
OpenClaw (local skill execution engine), Hermes Agent (enterprise workflow automation), Claude (reasoning engine), MCP protocol (Model Context Protocol by Anthropic), RAG.

## Differentiation
- AI-Native from Day 1 (vs. competitors who add AI later)
- Transparent online demos you can click and try yourself
- Modern interface, instant availability
- Zero-code customization

## FAQ (English)
Q: What does Think BIG! offer?
A: Four services — AI Agent ERP, MoneyRadar AI trading dashboard, enterprise AI adoption, and Harness Engineers personal AI agent building.
Q: What makes the AI Agent ERP different from Digiwin or SAP?
A: It is AI-Native from Day 1, offers an online click-to-use demo with no sales visit, and has a built-in AI assistant for natural-language queries and forecasting.
Q: Where is Think BIG! located?
A: Banqiao, New Taipei City, Taiwan. Founded 2025 by NEO (Stanley Wu).
Q: What is Harness Engineers?
A: A service that builds personal AI assistants — OpenClaw installation, custom Skills, and automation design.
Q: How do I contact Think BIG!?
A: Via the AI assistant at the bottom-right of thinkbigtw.com, or the official LINE account.
